review_comments.body: **Changelog entry exceeds length limit** The new model-default entry exceeds the repository’s 200-character limit for changelog entries. Shorten it or split it into smaller entries to satisfy this requirement before merging. ```suggestion - Update Anthropic's default primary model to `claude-sonnet-5-5` - Update Gemini's default primary model to `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` and fast model to `gemini-3.8-flash` ``` **Context Used:** .cursor/rules/packmind/standard-changelog.mdc ([source](https://github.com/packmindhub/packmind/blob/main/.cursor/rules/packmind/standard-changelog.mdc)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**History-path fix lacks tests** The new temperature tests call only `executePrompt`, but this PR also changes the separate request builder in `executePromptWithHistory`. Add matching tests for that method with a model that rejects temperature and an older model that accepts it. Otherwise, the history-path check can regress while all three new tests still pass.

Shortened to one 149-character entry: "Default models move to `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` and `gemini-3.8-flash`; Claude 5 and Opus 4.7+ no longer receive a temperature". Fixed in 57b11f3ff.

Added tests for `executePromptWithHistory`, the second place the temperature is set: a Claude 5 model does not receive it and an earlier model still does. The Claude 5 test fails if the guard on that path is removed. Added in 57b11f3ff.
